intent_contract.text: 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create a pixel-verifiable, complex reference-guided photograph in which a scheduled orbital-station inspection makes microgravity legible through unsupported bodies, divergent object orientations, and active handrail control.

Create a landscape visible-light operational documentary photograph inside a crowded orbital-station module during a scheduled inspection. Microgravity is made visible through simultaneous unsupported floating, divergent orientations, and handrail-based motion control. An original visibly adult station specialist floats diagonally with both feet visibly clear of every surface while hooked fingertips arrest motion on a handrail. The specialist's readable face shape, eye appearance, lower-face shape, hairline, and long dark wavy hair follow the attached portrait as appearance-only reference. At least three loose objects float unsupported at clearly different orientations; one soft equipment pouch appears upside down relative to the specialist. Dense station racks, handrails, cables, labeled equipment panels, and secured stowage establish a functional orbital interior. The wide composition presents several competing orientations rather than one organizing down direction, while crisp practical cabin light keeps the face, free-floating body, loose objects, and controlling hand contact simultaneously legible.

render_gates.description: The image visibly commits to one identifiable source medium or protocol rather than an unspecified digital mood.
Artifacts share one technically coherent failure family native to the selected medium or protocol.
A deliberate bounded rupture is compositionally legible instead of uniform decorative noise across the whole frame.
Enough subject and scene continuity survives across the break for the failed flow to remain perceptible.
The result is not carried by generic RGB separation, random static, scanlines, VHS texture, or unrelated effect stacking alone.

Without prompt text, a caption, or metadata, a viewer can infer the selected source-medium failure mechanism from the same fingerprint repeated at three or more separated image locations; merely noticing that the image looks broken fails.
Malformed anatomy, fused objects, broken text, muddy texture, or one isolated synthesis defect does not carry the intended medium-native glitch.
